citations.text: Hu et al. (2020). Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. NeurIPS.

description: Heterogeneous biomedical knowledge graph with 5 node types: drugs, diseases, proteins, side effects, and genes. Contains 51 different relation types representing various biomedical relationships (drug-target, gene-disease, protein-gene, disease-symptom, etc.). Useful for evaluating link prediction in highly heterogeneous, multi-relational knowledge graphs.
name: Open Graph Benchmark - BioKG (Biomedical Knowledge Graph)
